claims.claim: Joined SBT News in November 2025 and anchored its weekday newscast until October 2026
claims.note: Announcement 10 Nov 2025; retirement article says he left the Jornal do SBT News desk from Monday 26 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: TV Globo 1976 to 2004

claims.claim: Took over Jornal Nacional in 1983 alongside Cid Moreira

claims.claim: About six years later became anchor of Fantastico and Globo Reporter
claims.note: Folha de Pernambuco only.

claims.note: Folha de Pernambuco.

claims.note: Poder360 lists these in the network note.

claims.claim: JR 15 Minutos among his shows at Record
claims.note: Folha de Pernambuco lists it; Poder360 also lists it.

claims.note: Poder360: Tuesday 11 March 2025, 21 years at the station.

claims.claim: He said in a video he was heading to new challenges

claims.claim: The channel was due to launch on 15 December 2025
claims.note: Announcement.

claims.claim: First boa noite on the channel at 18:30 on 15 December 2025

claims.claim: Jornal do SBT News airs Monday to Friday 18:30 to 20:30 with Marina Demori

claims.claim: Answered Uma maravilha! when asked about a new project after five decades
claims.note: Verbatim.

claims.claim: Said news channels let the team take the main stories and examine them closely

claims.claim: Called his voice a divine gift; advised against very cold water because of thermal shock

claims.claim: Career of more than five decades
